newsitem.title: UK: Stanley Leisure shares up after H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Stanley Leisure shares up after H1 results.

text.p: Shares in racing and casino group Stanley Leisure Plc rose on Wednesday after the company reported increased first-half profits and expressed confidence about the second half of the year.
By 1045 GMT the shares were up 17-1/2p at 294p.

The group's pre-tax profits rose 21 percent to 7.4 million stg, with earnings per share up 19.9 percent at 4.51p. "Trading in the racing division since the half year has been good and we are pleased with the improvement in turnover and profitability," said chairman Leonard Steinberg.
The group raised its interim dividend by 20 percent to 1.2p.
